LITTLE THINGS WORTH KEEPING

Our keepsake journal.
DELIVERED WITH ALL MY LOVE♡FOR YOU

For you,
my baby.

I’m sorry for making you sad or angry, and for the times my teasing went too far.

I love you. I want to listen, respect your boundaries, and show more care in the little things.

You don’t owe me an answer right now. It’s my turn to do better. ♡

All my love,
Haris ♡

A LITTLE CHALLENGE. A LOT OF LOVE.

How to find my heart.

You’re the girl in pink. Haris is waiting at Promise Pier. Follow the golden trail. Hearts open when you arrive.

WASD: walk · Shift: run · Space: hop.
Drag: look around · Esc: stop walking.
M: world map · Click a heart to walk there.
E: reopen a nearby heart · Scroll: zoom.
F: talk to Haris · P: pause and settings.
